rationale: Homepage source work exists, but design acceptance remains unproven. T064 could not remove generated reparse-point links; browser, accessibility, visual, and final build evidence are still missing. Prior visual checks materially mismatched unchanged baselines. Approve one safe Windows-specific cleanup package.

worker_package.objective: Use Windows cmd.exe rmdir /q on each individually validated symbolic-link entry beneath the exact apps/web/.next path, without recursion or link following; remove the root only after a no-follow rescan confirms zero reparse points, then run e2e, accessibility, visual diagnostics, and the production build last. Preserve source, snapshots, reports, content, provenance, and unrelated workstreams.
verify: Guard exact absolute target apps/web/.next; reject missing target or reparse-point root.
Inspect 127.0.0.1:3101 before every Playwright command; proceed only when FREE or owned by this workspace, recording PID and command line.
Enumerate recursively only through non-reparse directories; for each validated SymbolicLink child run cmd.exe /d /c rmdir /q on that exact child path, never rmdir /s on a link or root.
Rescan without following links; only when zero reparse points remain may the exact .next root be removed recursively.
Run pnpm e2e, pnpm a11y, and pnpm visual:check; record visual mismatches diagnostically without visual:update or snapshot changes.
Run pnpm build last and record its actual exit status.
Confirm writes are limited to apps/web/.next and test-results; verify tests/browser/snapshots and source/configuration hashes remain unchanged.
stop_if: Target is not exactly apps/web/.next, root is a reparse point, or any reparse entry cannot be classified and removed as a link object.
cmd.exe rmdir /q returns an error, access is denied, or any operation would require following a junction or symlink.
Port 3101 is occupied by an unknown process or ownership cannot be established.
A required browser or build command fails twice for the same cause, or build cannot provide an actual successful exit status.
Any source, snapshot, report, content, provenance, configuration, documentation, search, governance, operations, or external-system change is required.
visual:update runs, snapshots change, assertions are weakened, or mismatched baselines are approved.
Any deletion or write affects a path outside apps/web/.next or test-results.

evidence: T064 exact target/root guard passed but Windows denied unlinking reparse-point children; browser and build checks were not run.
Current apps/web/.next contains 27 SymbolicLink reparse entries and 28 non-reparse directories.
fsutil confirms representative links use Microsoft Symbolic Link reparse tag 0xa000000c and target workspace node_modules outside .next.
Prior exact-target cleanups succeeded; T056 then found material light, mobile, and dark visual mismatches.
Current 127.0.0.1:3101 is FREE and visual:update is separate from visual:check.

parallel_safety.reason: Generated output, test-results, Playwright server ownership, and build/browser verification share one runtime boundary; run one sole Worker.

missing_evidence: Fresh light desktop, 390px mobile, and dark visual diagnostics with unchanged snapshots.
Production build with an actual successful exit status.
Repository-backed raster-media provenance and truthful font-loading evidence.
Full homepage acceptance against supplied references.
Completion evidence for documentation ingestion, search, governance, hardening, operations, and external activation.
